notes: More of the numbers you type are used as typed: a GIF asked for at 480 wide came out 640, “slow it to 0.25×” wasn’t understood at all, “play it at 2×” looped the clip twice instead of speeding it up, and “fade in over half a second” used the default length. Asking for a file size (“under 25MB”) now explains that Crisp compresses by quality rather than aiming at a size.
